title: abronia umbellata subsp. breviflora
intro: Abronia umbellata subsp. breviflora, commonly known as Dwarf Sand Verbena, is a plant species belonging to the Nyctaginaceae family. It is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico, valued for its potential health benefits and medicinal properties. The plant is reported to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in relieving pain, reducing inflammation, and protecting against cell damage. Bioactive constituents of Abronia umbellata subsp. breviflora include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
